QuestInfo.name: Letter for Lucas
QuestInfo.0: I heard Maria need a help...
QuestInfo.1: I met Maria who was desperately looking for help. She gave me a letter and asked me to bring this to Lucas in Amherst...
QuestInfo.2: I gave Maria's letter to Lucas in Amherst.

0.0: Ahh...I'm getting worried...because I need to get this letter to #p9201203# fast. It's an urgent matter so I need to let him know of this ASAP. Too bad I have things to do here for a while so I won't be leaving this spot anytime soon...
0.1: If you're not too busy, could you deliver this #bletter#k to #b#p9201203##k in #b#m690000018##k? I have things to take care of here.
0.2: I'm not asking Explorers 'cause I'm lazy or anything! This is a good way for you to learn the ropes! Besides, how could I possible go that far with my fragile body?

yes.0: You're gonna do it? Thank goodness. Now I can breathe a sigh of relief. Here's my letter, and please get this to the town chief that's at #b#m690000018##k.
yes.1: Head northeast and soon you'll find #b#m690000018##k. #p9201203# is the town chief of #m690000018#. He should be in front of the department store probably taking a walk. Please get #p9201203#'s reply letter fast!

no.0: Are you really busy? Ahhhh, this is not good. If I don't get this to the town chief... anyway if you have some free time please come back and talk to me.

item.0: The letter from #r#p2103##k should be here by now. What happened...? Someone please let me know what's going on here...

lost.0: You lost my letter!! You should have been more careful. Here's the letter again. Please make sure you don't lose the letter, since there are a lot monsters around this area.
